description: Overview of the stories (Textabschnitte) of the document: which frames belong to which story and in what order, and which story overflows. stories[] {story_id, frame_ids (chain order), frame_count, frames[] {frame_id, index, page_id, page_name, on_pasteboard, on_parent_page, bounds_mm}, character_count, paragraph_count, table_count, overset, on_parent_page, first_page_id, first_page_name, first_paragraph_style, snippet, lock_state, managed_file}, count, total_stories, overset_count (warning when above 0). Stories on parent pages are skipped unless include_parent_pages true; empty stories are listed unless include_empty false; page_id keeps only stories with a frame on that page. lock_state is the state of a story in an editorial workflow such as InCopy (none, unmanaged_story, checked_in_story, checked_out_story, locked_story, embedded_story, missing_lock_state, mixed_lock_state; null when unreadable); managed_file is the path of its editorial file (home folder as ~) for managed stories, otherwise null. Read-only. get_frame_text reads one story; thread_text_frames changes the chain.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_empty.description: List stories without text. Default true.

include_parent_pages.description: Also list stories on parent (master) pages. Default false.

page_id.description: Only stories that have a frame on this page.

snippet_chars.description: Length of the text snippet per story. Default 80.

name: list_stories
title: List stories
